explanation: The Almighty Ruler who sits on the throne and governs the final judgment of the world.
Christ's triumph over evil, represented by the Lamb's ability to open the scroll with seven seals.
Where God's throne is located, separated from the earth during the final events.
The place where people live and where judgment on sin will be fully carried out.
The evil spirit who deceives the nations into war against God's people before being bound for a thousand years.
A symbolic representation of hostile powers from the north that gather at the end of time.
A people or kingdom associated with Gog, depicted as a vast army under the devil's leadership.
Spiritual beings who serve God and carry out his judgment over the evil powers.
Place where the realm of the dead holds its prisoners before everything is restored to new life.
The very state of being dead, which together with Hades is cast into the lake of fire.
The place of eternal punishment where the wicked and Hades are finally destroyed.
Place of final judgment where all evil is wiped out forever.
Heavenly city that comes down from God, represented as the bride of the Lamb's victory.
